selection_fixture_scope: Local production client with ordinary training commands, explicit received death/removal fixtures, and captured payloads; no browser interaction or multiplayer claim.
fixture_scope: Production snapshots pass through Godot JSON serialization/parsing. Headless Window sizes actually change 640x820 -> 1280x820 -> 640x820. Explicit synthetic received-state health/effect/tower flags exercise normal presentation labels/tooltips. Selection checks call production methods directly with normal reserve/confirm training state, explicit death/removal snapshots, a synthetic key event, and a test-only CommandCapture transport subclass that records outgoing payloads without a peer. Server command checks validate ordinary acceptance and post-snapshot death rejection. This is automated regression, not real OS or browser input, multiplayer play, or human feedback.
fix_retest: SELECT-01: six reproduced 005 selection failures are corrected; 17 added regressions cover click/additive/drag selection, recalled groups, snapshot pruning, outgoing order/ability boundaries, training completion, and retained death visuals. Authority still rejects a unit that dies after the last valid snapshot. All original 63 JSON, layout, stable-scene, and tactical-feedback assertions remain passing.
